messages.subject: Trying to upload new version of shiny app, and getting no such file or directory error
parts: I am trying to upload the new version of my shiny app. I uploaded the new files then when I tried to run it I received the error of the program unexpectedly exited on the glimmer site. The rstudio screen in the glimmer auth website said that there was an error in trying to set the working directory. I then tried to create a new folder for the new shiny app so that it was in the current working directory. The glimmer auth website shut down. I then resigned in and when I tried to open my shiny app code, I got the error that while opening there was no such file or directory. The glimmer website gives an error of the application failed to start. Any help is much appreciated.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Trying to upload new version of shiny app, and getting no such file or directory error
parts:
It looks like you have a very old version of the shiny package installed in your private library. Can you try removing it (and shinyIncubator, which you don't need if you just want actionButton)?

If you don't have shiny in your private library then you default to glimmer's central copy of Shiny, which we keep pretty up-to-date (no older than the current CRAN release).
